meta.source: SYNTHETIC PREVIEW FIXTURE - invented people, not real testimonials

testimonials.name: Avery Sample
testimonials.message: The coaching rewired how I talk about my work. Two offers in five weeks.

testimonials.name: Casey Fixture
testimonials.message: I came to the coaching stuck. Not unemployed-stuck, but worse: employed and invisible. Six years of shipping product and I still could not answer "tell me about yourself" without apologising for half of it. What changed was not a template. It was being made to re-read my own history until the through-line was obvious, then to say it out loud until it stopped sounding rehearsed. We rebuilt the CV, then the profile, then the story underneath both. Three weeks later I had two first-round interviews from applications I had already been rejected from once. Six weeks later I had an offer at a level I had talked myself out of applying for. The salary conversation alone paid for the coaching several times over, and I still use that framing in every stakeholder meeting.

testimonials.name: Georgie Stub
testimonials.message:
Three things changed:

1. My CV finally said something.
2. I stopped apologising in interviews.
3. I asked for more money and got it.
